summary: Makes the multipart parser configurable per request through rack.request.config, the way the query parser already is. The env-reading half of Rack::Multipart.parse_multipart moves into a new Rack::Multipart::Parser.parse_from_env, whose tempfile factory, buffer size and query parser come from overridable class methods; Rack::Request#form_pairs now calls multipart_parser.parse_from_env(env), defaulting to a Request::MultipartParser subclass that keeps the old ParamList output. Built with --explain: no review, so no findings.
note: Code read at head 55f78e2844 (merged). Every edge cites a line at that SHA. No generated files or docs in the diff. BUFSIZE and TEMPFILE_FACTORY are folded into the default_* hooks that return them. No screenshots: a library PR with no visible surface.

modeNotes.before: Request#form_pairs calls Multipart.parse_multipart(env, ParamList), which reads the env and calls Parser.parse itself.
modeNotes.after: Request#form_pairs asks multipart_parser (config or Request::MultipartParser) to parse_from_env; parse_multipart is a one-line delegate.

nodes.name: POST
bullets: Public entry: the parsed request body
nodes.summary: The public method apps call for body params. Untouched here; it reaches the changed code through form_pairs, so it is the call the new spec drives.

nodes.name: form_pairs
bullets: Parses the body into key/value pairs
nodes.summary: Turns a form or multipart body into pairs and caches them in the env. The one-line change swaps the hard-wired Multipart.parse_multipart(env, ParamList) for multipart_parser.parse_from_env(env), which is what lets a request pick its own parser.
facts: urlencoded parse when parse_from_env returns nil

nodes.name: parse_multipart
nodes.summary: The deprecated Request#parse_multipart still goes through Multipart.extract_multipart, so it now lands on Parser.parse_from_env with the default parser rather than the request's configured one.

nodes.name: spec_request.rb
nodes.summary: One new example: a subclass of Request::MultipartParser whose default_tempfile_factory raises is passed as rack.request.config's :multipart_parser, and req.POST on a multipart body must raise that error. It proves the config is consulted and that the default_* hooks are honoured.
changes: Adds "should use the multipart_parser from environment for multipart parsing"

nodes.name: config_value
nodes.summary: env.dig(RACK_REQUEST_CONFIG, key). Existing helper; the PR adds a second key (:multipart_parser) beside :query_parser.

nodes.name: multipart_parser
bullets: Picks the parser class for this request
nodes.summary: New private method mirroring query_parser: returns config_value(:multipart_parser) or Request::MultipartParser. Whatever it returns only needs to respond to parse_from_env(env).

nodes.name: MultipartParser
nodes.summary: The default multipart parser for a request. Its only change from Multipart::Parser is default_query_parser → ParamList, which keeps form_pairs receiving a pair list as before. A custom parser that subclasses Multipart::Parser directly inherits Utils.default_query_parser instead, so subclassing this class is the safe extension point.
changes: Adds class MultipartParser < Multipart::Parser with self.default_query_parser

nodes.name: parse_multipart
bullets: Public multipart entry, kept for callers
Body moved out; now a one-line delegate
nodes.summary: Still the public module function (spec_multipart.rb calls it 84 times), but its 16-line body moved verbatim into Parser.parse_from_env. It now passes its params argument through as query_parser:.
changes: Removes the env reads, Parser.parse call and RACK_TEMPFILES write

nodes.name: extract_multipart
nodes.summary: Unchanged wrapper used by the deprecated Request#parse_multipart. It ignores its params argument, so it always parses with the default query parser.

nodes.name: ParamList
nodes.summary: Pair-list accumulator with the QueryParser API (make_params, normalize_params). form_pairs used to pass it explicitly; now Request::MultipartParser returns it from default_query_parser.

nodes.name: spec_multipart.rb
nodes.summary: Unchanged, but it is the regression net for the move: every Multipart.parse_multipart example now exercises Parser.parse_from_env.

nodes.name: parse_from_env
nodes.summary: The old parse_multipart body, moved: read rack.input, CONTENT_LENGTH and CONTENT_TYPE, choose tempfile factory and buffer size (env override, else the default_* hook), call parse, store tmp_files in rack.tempfiles and return params. The hooks are called on self, so a subclass's overrides apply.

nodes.name: default_tempfile_factory
nodes.summary: New overridable hook returning the TEMPFILE_FACTORY lambda. The new spec overrides it to refuse uploads. rack.multipart.tempfile_factory in the env still wins over it.

nodes.name: default_bufsize
nodes.summary: New overridable hook returning BUFSIZE. rack.multipart.buffer_size in the env still wins over it.

nodes.name: default_query_parser
nodes.summary: New hook that supplies parse_from_env's query_parser: default. On the base class it returns Utils.default_query_parser (hash output); Request::MultipartParser overrides it with ParamList (pair output).

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Unchanged six-argument parse. Its caller moved from Multipart.parse_multipart to Parser.parse_from_env.

nodes.name: default_query_parser
nodes.summary: Rack::Utils.default_query_parser, a module attr_accessor. Already the default argument of parse_multipart; now also what Parser.default_query_parser returns.

nodes.name: rack.request.config
nodes.summary: A hash in the env that middleware or the server sets to configure Rack::Request. Before this PR it carried :query_parser; it now also carries :multipart_parser.

nodes.name: rack.input · CONTENT_*
bullets: Request body stream and its headers
nodes.summary: The body IO and its length and content type. Read exactly as before, from the new location.

nodes.name: rack.multipart.*
nodes.summary: rack.multipart.tempfile_factory and rack.multipart.buffer_size. When set they win over the parser class's default_* hooks, as they won over the constants before.

nodes.name: rack.tempfiles
nodes.summary: Where the parser records the tempfiles it created so Rack::TempfileReaper can close them. Written as before, from the new location.

c-formPairs: # Otherwise, figure out how to parse the input:
# Add 2 bytes. One to check whether it is over the limit, and a second
# in case the slice! call below removes the last byte
c-requestMultipartParser: +        # The default query parser used by the multipart parser.
c-reqParseMultipart: warn "Rack::Request#parse_multipart is deprecated and will be removed in a future version of Rack.", uplevel: 1
c-parseMultipart: -        info = Parser.parse(io, content_length, content_type, tempfile, bufsize, params)
c-parseFromEnv: +        info = parse(io, content_length, content_type, tempfile, bufsize, query_parser)
c-parserParse: def self.parse(io, content_length, content_type, tmpfile, bufsize, qp)
raise Error, "multipart Content-Length #{content_length} exceeds limit of #{PARSER_BYTESIZE_LIMIT} bytes"
c-paramList: # Accumulator for multipart form data, conforming to the QueryParser API.
# In future, the Parser could return the pair list directly, but that would
c-specRequest: +  it "should use the multipart_parser from environment for multipart parsing" do
c-specMultipart: it "allows requests within the total bytesize limit" do
